needed.evidence: A narrow, unpaved strip of grass and dirt runs along the right edge of the road, serving as a path for a pedestrian but lacking a proper, paved sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, level sidewalk along the right side of the road to provide a safe and accessible route for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There is a clear demand to cross the road to access the businesses on the right, but no marked or unmarked crossing facility is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing (zebra crossing) at the entrance to the commercial area on the right to provide a safe place for people to cross.
